verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation is a fair axis for an AI API platform, but the evidence pack never documents rules, triggers, webhooks, or event-driven actions. Tool and function calling let the model invoke actions during a conversation, and the Batch API processes requests asynchronously. Neither lets a user define rules that fire automatically on events, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
